cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID. One displaced woman paid through a banking app in 2024 does not carry the country, and in 2024 refugee ID cards did not meet the SIM registration rule.
cells.note: Restaged under messages-for-bill 135 (a registered count is enough): the Commission for Refugees holds a UNHCR-approved registry of over 950,000 refugees (SDN-002, May 2026). One displaced woman's banking app (SDN-004, classed other) does not show displaced people may use such services, so not 4.
